name: Coderhouse
long_description: Coderhouse is Latin America’s largest live online learning community, with 500k+ alumni. We run live online tech cohorts taught by practitioners from companies like Google, Apple, Meta, and Tesla. On top of live classes, AI agents give each student personal feedback, practice, and support at scale, so learning stays hands-on without losing the human teacher. Students ship real projects and leave with skills they can use on the job. We’re expanding into the US with courses like AI Engineering and Data Analytics.
one_liner: Live online courses that turn learners into builders
